overview: The board approved a special permit for a home addition, a lot-width variance for a two-family conversion, and a parking variance to allow flood mitigation at a residential property.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The board entered executive session to discuss pending litigation in the case of Rifa et al. v. Caldera ZBA et al.

items.title: 86 Suffolk Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to allow a one-story addition that extends an existing non-conforming rear yard setback.

items.title: 13 Marion Street
items.summary: Approved a variance for lot width to permit the conversion of a single-family dwelling into a two-family dwelling.

items.title: 35-37 Lincoln Street
items.summary: Approved a parking variance to allow the infilling of a below-grade driveway and garage to prevent chronic flooding, resulting in the loss of one required off-street parking space.

items.title: Administrative Items
items.summary: The board deferred the approval of minutes and scheduled the next meeting for September 26, 2024.
